nodes.label: api/utils/backups/accountInventory.ts

nodes.label: Cloud Folder Capture
nodes.rationale: Folder capture freezes a selected folder's exact inventory into the existing immutable plan, keeping cloud-folder scope and its completeness limits explicit.

nodes.label: manifest.ts
nodes.rationale: The versioned format makes coverage explicit and commits ordered bounded manifest pages and immutable content ranges into a completion seal.

nodes.label: portableBackup.ts

nodes.label: cloudBackupTree.ts
nodes.rationale: A private disposable SQLite index enables duplicate/path/parent validation and ordered enumeration without retaining an entire folder tree in memory.
